headline: Copper and Tin Prices Fall Amid Broader AI Stock Selloff
summary: Copper declined 1.2% to $14,180 per ton in Shanghai, while tin dropped 2.2% to $48,550 per ton alongside a broader selloff in artificial intelligence equities.
why: Industrial metals such as copper and tin are critical raw materials for semiconductor packaging, electronics manufacturing, and power infrastructure.

impacts.name: Copper futures
impacts.why: Copper prices fell 1.2% in Shanghai trading following weakness in tech stocks.
